inputs.obb_geometry: existing semseg_obb_v0 features from the row-preserving geometry join
inputs.object_metadata: object labels and object ids from 3DSSG/3RScan context
inputs.optional_visual_context: not used by extractor contract; reserved for later audit only
inputs.prediction_jsonl: VL-SAT/Open3DSG/GT/counterfactual rows with scan_id, subgraph_id, subject_id, object_id, predicate_label
inputs.segmented_points: labels.instances.annotated.v2.ply or staged point evidence when available

metric_block: Do not run source metrics from this contract. Metrics require verifier/calibration gates after extractor implementation.

phases.description: Preserve source row identity and copy OBB distance/overlap/vertical features.
phases.name: identity_and_obb_pass_through

phases.description: Estimate min point distance, near-contact counts, and contact patch proxy for the subject-object pair.
phases.name: local_point_contact_estimation

phases.description: Collect wall/ceiling/furniture/fixture/object-part surface candidates and classify normals.
phases.name: surface_candidate_estimation

phases.description: Compute hanging plausibility and competing floor/table support explanation fields.
phases.name: gravity_and_contradictory_support_cues

phases.description: Assign a conservative subtype hint and class-pair affordance context without making a validity decision.
phases.name: subtype_hint_and_context
